doc_kind: clinical policy (Pennsylvania Health and Wellness, Centene, PA.CP.MP.119)
lines_of_business: Not stated beyond the plan name 'Pennsylvania Health and Wellness (PHW)'; a Medicaid managed-care plan, but the document does not say so
criteria_location: Policy/Criteria, pp. 1-2 of 6: one 'I.' list with A (diagnosis, 2 branches), B (medical therapy), C (etiology ruled out) and a second list headed 'I.' (not medically necessary).
procedures_covered: Balloon sinuplasty / sinus ostial dilation of maxillary, sphenoid and frontal ostia (31295-31298), alone or with endoscopic sinus surgery

logic.top_level: all (A and B and C), where A is any-of two diagnosis pathways

k_of_n.quote: Has at least one of the following symptoms: Anterior or posterior mucopurulent nasal discharge; Nasal obstruction; Facial pain/pressure/fullness; Decreased or lost sense of smell
Has at least two of the following symptoms: Purulent rhinorrhea; Nasal obstruction; Facial pressure/pain; Cough
Computed tomography (CT) scan shows either of the following: Polyps ... and/or sinus opacification; Inflammation of the paranasal sinuses
Has at least one of the following findings: Endoscopic signs of mucosal edema, purulent drainage, or nasal polyposis; Mucosal changes within the ostiomeatal complex and/or sinuses, by CT scan
Antibiotic therapy meeting one of the following (a or b)

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: A second list headed 'not medically necessary in any of the following situations': ethmoid disease; extensive previous sinus surgery with significant osteoneogenesis. Also C: allergic or immune etiologies ruled out or treated.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: a. If > 18 years of age, meets both ... b. If ≤ 18 years of age
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Age band split: > 18 vs ≤ 18, so an 18-year-old falls in the pediatric branch, whereas most definitions of adult are 18 and over.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Polyps in nasal cavity or the middle meatus, and/or sinus opacification
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' inside one CT option; polyps in the nasal cavity are not a sinus CT finding of the ostium to be dilated.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Therapy guided by culture and sensitivity for ≥ 3 weeks; b. Beta-lactamase resistant antibiotic for ≥ 3 weeks (e.g., amoxicillin [recommended], amoxicillin-clavulanate ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Amoxicillin is listed as a beta-lactamase resistant antibiotic; plain amoxicillin is not beta-lactamase resistant. Examples in the criteria may be taken literally.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Continued symptoms after medical therapy consisting of both of the following (1 and 2): ... B.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: B's required medical therapy (antibiotics 3 weeks, steroids 4 weeks) is required for both CRS and RARS pathways although A.2 (RARS) has no persistent symptoms between episodes.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: I. It is the policy of PHW that balloon sinuplasty is not medically necessary in any of the following situations
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Second list is numbered 'I.' again, so heading numbering cannot be used to separate the criteria from the exclusions.

Documented ≥ 4 episodes of acute bacterial rhinosinusitis in the past year without signs or symptoms of rhinosinusitis between episodes
Has at least one of the following symptoms ... (adults); at least two of the following symptoms ... (18 or under)
Computed tomography (CT) scan shows either of the following: Polyps ... sinus opacification; Inflammation of the paranasal sinuses
Antibiotic therapy ... Therapy guided by culture and sensitivity for ≥ 3 weeks; Beta-lactamase resistant antibiotic for ≥ 3 weeks
Allergic or immune etiologies of symptoms have been ruled out or treated appropriately
If > 18 years of age ... If ≤ 18 years of age
not medically necessary: For the treatment of ethmoid disease; Extensive previous sinus surgery with significant osteoneogenesis

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: CPT 31295-31298 listed; 'ICD-10-CM Diagnosis Codes that Support Coverage Criteria' lists J01.01, J01.11, J01.31 (acute recurrent maxillary/frontal/sphenoidal) and J32.0, J32.1, J32.3 (chronic maxillary/frontal/sphenoidal). Ethmoid and pansinusitis codes are absent, consistent with the ethmoid exclusion.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: none; 'other' and 'unspecified' ICD codes removed in 10/18

external_dependencies.what: Society positions cited as support, not as delegated criteria
external_dependencies.quote: strong consensus that CT documentation of sinonasal disease is required before surgical management with balloon sinus ostial dilation (AAO 2018 Consensus Statement)

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: an inflammatory condition involving the paranasal sinuses and linings of the nasal passages, which persists for 12 weeks or longer
4 or more episodes of ABRS within a year, without persistent symptoms between episodes

vague_terms.quote: Allergic or immune etiologies of symptoms have been ruled out or treated appropriately
vague_terms.problem: 'ruled out' how (testing?); 'appropriately' undefined; a chart often has nothing on this

vague_terms.quote: Extensive previous sinus surgery with significant osteoneogenesis
vague_terms.problem: 'extensive' and 'significant' undefined; osteoneogenesis is a CT/exam judgment

vague_terms.quote: For the treatment of ethmoid disease
vague_terms.problem: unclear whether any ethmoid involvement excludes, even when dilating maxillary/frontal/sphenoid

vague_terms.quote: Documented ≥ 4 episodes of acute bacterial rhinosinusitis
vague_terms.problem: how an episode is documented (culture, clinician diagnosis) is not defined

extraction_hazards: Roman numeral 'I.' is used twice (criteria and exclusions); lettering A, B, C then a restart.
Page break between A.2.b.i and A.2.b.ii splits a list; header 'CLINICAL POLICY / Balloon Sinuplasty' repeats at each page top.
Trailing '. .' after item C and typo-like punctuation.
Revision-log table lines wrap and are split across pages; the log describes earlier versions of the criteria (e.g., adults once could qualify by endoscopy) which could be mistaken for current rules.
Background restates definitions and includes 'more than three courses of antibiotics in 12 months' not in the criteria.
interesting_structures: Age-banded criteria: adult (>18) needs 1 symptom + CT; child (<=18) needs 2 symptoms + endoscopy or CT.
Two diagnosis pathways (CRS and RARS) with a shared medical-therapy requirement and etiology clause.
Medical therapy defined with drug-class examples and minimum durations, with an either/or on culture-guided vs beta-lactamase resistant antibiotic.
ICD-10 codes listed as 'support coverage criteria'; six codes only, sinus-specific.
Revision log shows the criteria evolving (adult endoscopy option removed in 10/19).

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = clean, 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Well-formed all/any/k-of-n with numeric thresholds and clear numbering. Strain: age band branches, the culture-vs-empiric antibiotic alternative, an etiology 'ruled out' leaf that charts rarely contain, and the duplicate numbering of the exclusion list.
